opening.text: A fire in the fireplace warms a home. The same fire, outside the fireplace, can burn the house down. The fire isn't bad. It just needs its place. The law of chastity is like that. God gave us sacred powers. He also told us where they belong.

mainMessage.text: The law of chastity protects something sacred. Kept in its place, it brings joy. And for anyone who has strayed, the way back is open.

blocks.text: **The fire in its place** God's laws are given for our happiness. This one is no different.
Do not suppose, because it has been spoken concerning restoration, that ye shall be restored from sin to happiness. Behold, I say unto you, wickedness never was happiness.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.
The law leads to happiness.
**Why the fire matters** The body is not an accessory. It is part of who we are.
And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
The body is an essential part of the soul.
That is why this law matters.
**Living in the light** The fire brings warmth and light when it is kept where it belongs. Heavenly Father wants us in that light.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Heavenly Father desires us to be together in the light and filled with hope.
He wants us in the light.
**When the fire has spread** Some have broken this law. Be honest about it. The road back is real, but it isn't always easy.

Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
In such serious matters the path of repentance is not easily begun nor painlessly traveled.
Be honest, and begin.
**Made clean again** The Lord does not leave a burned place burned. He renews it.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
The results of sincere repentance are peace of conscience, comfort, and spiritual healing and renewal.
Peace and renewal follow.
**You do not walk alone** No one has to rebuild by themselves. The Savior offers rest to the weary.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
But the Savior of the world will walk that essential journey with you.
He walks with you.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when they chose purity, or when the Savior helped them start again. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: Joseph in Egypt

blocks.text: Joseph served in the house of an Egyptian officer. The officer's wife pressed him to sin.

There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
Joseph didn't argue or stay to test himself. He ran. He knew his loyalty was first to God. Sometimes the strongest thing to do is leave.

application.text: First, decide now what you will do before a hard moment comes. Second, tell one trusted person about your standard. Third, if you have strayed, speak with your bishop. He can help you start.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know God gave us this law because He loves us. I know His power to forgive is real. I know Jesus Christ makes us clean and whole. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

opening.text: A river is a powerful thing. Inside its banks, it gives water, power and life. Without banks, it floods and destroys. The banks don't hold the river back. They make it useful. The law of chastity is the riverbank for one of God's greatest gifts.

mainMessage.text: The law of chastity gives our most sacred power its banks, so it blesses and doesn't destroy. And the Savior can restore a river that has flooded.

blocks.text: **Banks that give life** The banks make the river a blessing. God's law makes this gift a blessing too.
Do not suppose, because it has been spoken concerning restoration, that ye shall be restored from sin to happiness. Behold, I say unto you, wickedness never was happiness.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.
The banks bring joy.
**Something deep runs here** This river runs through the center of who we are. The body and spirit together make the soul.
And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
The body is an essential part of the soul.
It runs deep.
**Clear water, clear light** A river kept in its course runs clear. Light shines through it. Heavenly Father wants that for us.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Heavenly Father desires us to be together in the light and filled with hope.
The water runs clear.
**After the flood** Sometimes a river breaks its banks. Then there is damage. Repair takes honest work.

Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
In such serious matters the path of repentance is not easily begun nor painlessly traveled.
Repair takes effort.
**The river returns to its bed** After the flood, the water goes down. The land heals. Repentance brings the same peace.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
The results of sincere repentance are peace of conscience, comfort, and spiritual healing and renewal.
The land heals.
**Help with the repair** No one rebuilds alone. The Savior comes to those who are tired and weighed down.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
But the Savior of the world will walk that essential journey with you.
He walks with you.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when a clear standard kept them safe. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: Job's covenant with his eyes

blocks.text: Job set a rule for himself long before temptation came.
I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
Job made his choice early. He guarded what he looked at and what he thought about. A river kept in its banks begins with small choices.

application.text: First, decide what you will not look at or dwell on. Second, fill that space with something good. Third, if you have crossed the line, talk with your bishop. He wants to help.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know the law of chastity is a gift and not a burden. I know the Savior heals what is broken. I know Jesus Christ is mighty to save. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

opening.text: Imagine a vault in a bank. Inside are things that can't be replaced. The walls are thick. The door is heavy. Nobody calls the vault unfair. They call it wise. Some things are so valuable that they need strong protection. The law of chastity guards a treasure like that.

mainMessage.text: The law of chastity guards a treasure. God asks us to protect it because He knows its worth. And if the vault has been opened, He can help us restore what was lost.

blocks.text: **The worth of the treasure** We guard what we value. God values our happiness, so He gave us this law.
Do not suppose, because it has been spoken concerning restoration, that ye shall be restored from sin to happiness. Behold, I say unto you, wickedness never was happiness.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.
The treasure is our happiness.
**What is inside** The treasure isn't just a rule. It is our body and spirit joined as one soul.
And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
The body is an essential part of the soul.
What is inside is you.
**Light in the vault** A vault is dark until someone opens it with care. God invites us to walk in the light.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Heavenly Father desires us to be together in the light and filled with hope.
Hope is in the light.
**When the door was forced** Some treasures have been taken. It is painful to face. But facing it is where recovery starts.

Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
In such serious matters the path of repentance is not easily begun nor painlessly traveled.
Face it, and start.
**What is restored** The Lord can give back what seemed lost. Peace comes first.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
The results of sincere repentance are peace of conscience, comfort, and spiritual healing and renewal.
Renewal is real.
**Someone to carry it with you** The way back can feel heavy. The Savior carries the weight with us.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
But the Savior of the world will walk that essential journey with you.
He carries it with you.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when they felt the Savior's mercy after a mistake. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The woman and the Savior

blocks.text: A woman was brought before Jesus Christ by people who wanted to condemn her. They all left. Only she and the Savior remained.

When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee? She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
He did not shame her. He gave her mercy, and He gave her a call to change. Both are part of His love.

application.text: First, remember that your worth does not change. Second, set one boundary that protects you. Third, if you carry a weight, talk to your bishop this week.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know I am a child of God and so is everyone I meet. I know His law protects what is sacred. I know Jesus Christ forgives and restores. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

opening.text: A white shirt shows every stain. Spill something on it, and you see it right away. But you can also wash it. A good cleaner can bring it back to white. The law of chastity is about keeping clean. And the gospel is about being washed when we are not.

mainMessage.text: The law of chastity asks us to stay clean. The Savior offers to make us clean again.

blocks.text: **Choosing to stay clean** Keeping clean is easier than cleaning up. God gives this law so that we can be happy.
Do not suppose, because it has been spoken concerning restoration, that ye shall be restored from sin to happiness. Behold, I say unto you, wickedness never was happiness.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.
Clean brings joy.
**More than skin deep** The stain isn't on the surface only. Body and spirit are joined, so what touches one touches the other.
And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
The body is an essential part of the soul.
It reaches the soul.
**Seen in the light** In good light, we see clearly. That is a gift, not a threat. The light shows us the way.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Heavenly Father desires us to be together in the light and filled with hope.
Light brings hope.
**The stain is real** A stain left alone sets. Sin works the same way. The Lord asks us to deal with it honestly.

Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
In such serious matters the path of repentance is not easily begun nor painlessly traveled.
Deal with it honestly.
**White as snow** The Lord promised that even deep stains can come out. Repentance brings peace.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
The results of sincere repentance are peace of conscience, comfort, and spiritual healing and renewal.
The stain can come out.
**The Cleaner stays with you** Cleaning takes time. The Savior doesn't hand us a cloth and leave. He stays with us through it.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
But the Savior of the world will walk that essential journey with you.
He stays with you.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when they came home to the Lord after being away. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The father who ran

blocks.text: A young man left home and wasted what he had. Then he turned back.
And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
The father was watching the road. He ran to meet his son. Our Father in Heaven is like that. Coming home is always worth it.

application.text: First, choose one habit that keeps you clean in mind and body. Second, avoid places and media that pull you down. Third, if you are far from home, take one step back this week.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know Heavenly Father watches the road for each of us. I know repentance is a gift. I know Jesus Christ can make us clean. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

opening.text: Think of a road home at night. There are lights along the way. They don't take away your freedom. They help you find your way. Heavenly Father's commandments are lights like that. The law of chastity is one of them. It helps us walk safely. And if we have wandered off the road, the lights are still on.

mainMessage.text: The law of chastity is a light on the road home. If we have wandered, we can always turn back.

blocks.text: **Lights that lead to joy** The lights are placed for our good. This law points toward happiness.
Do not suppose, because it has been spoken concerning restoration, that ye shall be restored from sin to happiness. Behold, I say unto you, wickedness never was happiness.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.
Follow the lights home.
**Who is walking** The traveler is a whole person, body and spirit together.
And the spirit and the body are the soul of man.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
The body is an essential part of the soul.
The whole person walks.
**Walking in the light** If we walk in the light, we are not alone. We have company, and we have hope.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
Heavenly Father desires us to be together in the light and filled with hope.
We walk with others.
**Lost on the road** Some of us have wandered into the dark. It helps to say so plainly. Turning back takes courage.

Behold, he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. By this ye may know if a man repenteth of his sins—behold, he will confess them and forsake them.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
In such serious matters the path of repentance is not easily begun nor painlessly traveled.
Turning back takes courage.
**The way back is lit** The lights are still on. The Lord promised that scarlet can become white.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “We Believe in Being Chaste” from the April 2013 general conference.
The results of sincere repentance are peace of conscience, comfort, and spiritual healing and renewal.
The way is lit.
**A companion for the road** You don't have to find the way alone. The Savior comes to meet the weary.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Personal Purity” from the October 1998 general conference.
But the Savior of the world will walk that essential journey with you.
He walks beside you.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when they felt a change of heart. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: A mighty change

blocks.text: King Benjamin's people heard his words and felt the Spirit. They described what happened inside them.

And they all cried with one voice, saying: Yea, we believe all the words which thou hast spoken unto us; and also, we know of their surety and truth, because of the Spirit of the Lord Omnipotent, which has wrought a mighty change in us, or in our hearts, that we have no more disposition to do evil, but to do good continually.
The change was in their hearts. It wasn't only a change in what they did. That is what the Savior offers. A new heart helps us keep the law with joy.

application.text: First, pick one “light”, like prayer, scripture study or a trusted friend, that helps you stay on the road. Second, use it every day this week. Third, if you have wandered, take the first step back and speak with your bishop.

testimony.prompt: The member adds their own words. Lines the app offers:

blocks.text: I know Heavenly Father wants all His children home. I know His commandments are lights, not chains. I know Jesus Christ walks with us on the way. I say these things in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

sources.verses: Alma 41:10; Doctrine and Covenants 88:15; 1 John 1:7; Doctrine and Covenants 58:42–43; Isaiah 1:18; Matthew 11:28; Genesis 39:9, 12; Job 31:1; John 8:10–11; Luke 15:20; Mosiah 5:2.
